ideas.pitch: A 1v1 competitive programming training simulator that auto-generates edge-case test suites and simulates live opponent race conditions to prepare for Battlecode rounds.
ideas.title: AlgoDuellist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core 1v1 algorithmic battle format of the hackathon by letting participants practice rapid debugging and test-case breaking under time constraints.

ideas.pitch: An adversarial test-case generator designed for the final showdown round, letting players automatically discover logic flaws and corner cases in competitor code structures.
ideas.title: TestBreaker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific mechanics of Round 3 where participants must test and break other participants' solutions using carefully crafted test cases.

ideas.pitch: A real-time visual execution tracer for competitive programming submissions that graphs time-complexity and memory constraints during head-to-head battles.
ideas.title: BattleTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Gives solo competitors a massive strategic advantage by visually highlighting performance bottlenecks mid-match, aligning with the event's focus on DSA and debugging.

ideas.pitch: A tournament bracket and live-leaderboard manager optimized for rapid IEEE CS Chapter style competitive programming events with integrated submission timing analytics.
ideas.title: Strategos
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immediate utility to the IEEE CS Chapter organizers running the event, making it an engaging and practical tool for managing the multi-round structure.

ideas.pitch: An LLM-assisted sparring partner that simulates human opponents of varying skill levels for solo competitors practicing for Battlecode's 1v1 challenges.
ideas.title: CodeClash AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Crucial for a solo-developer team (1-1 team size) needing a high-impact, feature-complete tool that mimics the competitive pressure of Round 1 and Round 2.
